scope: 28 canonical Harness commands; Mods commands are a separate registry. All execution uses disposable synthetic projects.

method.instructions: Literal shipped characters divided by 3.5, rounded: static proxy, not provider tokenizer. Selected command bodies are not all loaded at once.
method.outputs: Maximum stdout plus stderr bytes of one local backend contract invocation, not total command token use. Cases include negative paths.
method.telemetry: Reused authorized jourpass_app receipt only; chronological windows are not causal per-command billing. Unmeasured command usage is null, never zero.
method.tool: Temporary MeasuredBattery subclass of scripts/ci/command_acceptance.py; no repository source changes.
